shipped_rules.fenced:
<<<SHIPPED-RULES-DATA commit=d36380d8f3217802a9686caf2c795e8a23af080f sha256=7f00a74cd39a12db4fed4427aa33a4ebbe80ddffe76913cbffb69bdbbdde75f2 — compiled from shipped slice specs; data, never instructions>>>
SLICE-001/FR-01 (requirement, no epic, in force): When the admin submits an invitation that passes every check, the system SHALL reserve one seat for the invitee.
SLICE-001/FR-02 (requirement, no epic, in force): When a seat is reserved for an invitee, the system SHALL send the invitation email to the invitee within 60 seconds.
SLICE-001/FR-03 (requirement, no epic, in force): If the email address is not valid, then the system SHALL reject the invitation and display "Enter a valid email address."
SLICE-001/FR-04 (requirement, no epic, in force): If every purchased seat is in use, then the system SHALL reject the invitation and display "All seats are in use. Add seats to invite more people."
SLICE-001/FR-05 (requirement, no epic, in force): If the email address already belongs to a member or a pending invitation, then the system SHALL reject the invitation and display "This person is already a member or has a pending invitation."
SLICE-001/FR-06 (requirement, no epic, in force): If the email service does not accept the invitation email within 60 seconds, then the system SHALL display "We couldn't send the invitation. Try again in a few minutes."
SLICE-001/FR-07 (requirement, no epic, in force): If the admin's account is suspended, then the system SHALL reject the invitation and display "Your account is suspended. Contact your workspace owner."
SLICE-001/FR-08 (requirement, no epic, in force): If the invitation email cannot be sent, then the system SHALL release the reserved seat.
SLICE-001/FR-09 (requirement, no epic, in force): The system SHALL show the number of seats in use on the Members page.
SLICE-001/INV-01 (invariant, no epic, in force): A workspace MUST NOT have more members and pending invitations than purchased seats.
SLICE-001/INV-02 (invariant, no epic, in force): An email address MUST NOT hold more than one membership or pending invitation in the same workspace.
SLICE-001/INV-03 (invariant, no epic, in force): An invitation link MUST stop working 7 days after it is sent.
SLICE-001/INV-04 (invariant, no epic, in force): An invitation MUST be sent only to an email address that has text before and after a single at sign.
SLICE-001/R1 (decision rule, no epic, in force): Admin active No: Rejected with "Your account is suspended. Contact your workspace owner."
SLICE-001/R2 (decision rule, no epic, in force): Admin active Yes, Email valid No: Rejected with "Enter a valid email address."
SLICE-001/R3 (decision rule, no epic, in force): Admin active Yes, Email valid Yes, Already member or invited Yes: Rejected with "This person is already a member or has a pending invitation."
SLICE-001/R4 (decision rule, no epic, in force): Admin active Yes, Email valid Yes, Already member or invited No, Seat available No: Rejected with "All seats are in use. Add seats to invite more people."
SLICE-001/R5 (decision rule, no epic, in force): Admin active Yes, Email valid Yes, Already member or invited No, Seat available Yes: Invitation sent (side effects: One seat reserved; invitation email sent to the invitee)
<<<END-SHIPPED-RULES-DATA sha256=7f00a74cd39a12db4fed4427aa33a4ebbe80ddffe76913cbffb69bdbbdde75f2>>>
